Subject: Proposal: phased uplift + 90-day price anchor (draft)

Hi Alice / Tom — looping in the pricing lead and legal touchpoints so we can move quickly.

Summary of our proposed structure (draft):

- Uplift: +50 GPU-hours/week (committed for 12 weeks, May 15–Aug 7).
- Billing: uplift billed monthly at current committed unit rate.
- Credit: Redwood issues a one-time credit equal to 20% of uplift charges, spread over the 3 billing cycles (applied as account credit).
- Price hold: baseline unit price for your base commitment (pre-uplift volume) held for 90 days from May 15 (no upward repricing during that window).
- Governance: automatic rollback if sustained usage drops >40% vs. baseline for two consecutive weeks.

Key trade-offs: the credit is intended to offset short-term cash pressure; since the uplift is timebound we limit long-term margin exposure. If you prefer a true step-down pricing (tiered rates) we can model revenue-neutral variants.

Next steps: if you confirm the uplift quantity we will produce a short amendment (2–3 pages) and a one-line DocuSign for signature. Lauren — can you confirm we can approve a 20% credit on uplift for this account and a 90-day anchor?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
